📚 1. 15 Từ Vựng Cốt Lõi (Kèm Phát Âm Audio Bản Xứ)

Bấm vào nút 🔊 để nghe phát âm chuẩn bản xứ của từng từ vựng (trên iPhone, hãy gạt cần rung sang chế độ Chuông để bật loa ngoài). Hệ thống tối ưu hiển thị linh hoạt trên cả điện thoại, máy tính bảng và máy tính:

⚠️ BẠN ĐANG MỞ Ở CHẾ ĐỘ XEM TRƯỚC — ÂM THANH SẼ KHÔNG CHẠY
Ứng dụng Tệp (Files) và Zalo trên iPhone chặn JavaScript, nên nút 🔊, chấm điểm và micro đều bị vô hiệu.
👉 Hãy mở bài học bằng đường link https:// mà giáo viên gửi (bấm vào link trong Zalo ➔ chọn biểu tượng la bàn Safari).
Bấm để máy tự động đọc lần lượt từng từ và hiển thị theo dõi (phù hợp học trên điện thoại)
1. expenditure (n)
/ɪkˈspendɪtʃə(r)/
chi tiêu, khoản kinh phí chi ra (từ học thuật C1 thay cho spending)
Collocation: household expenditure, government expenditure on
"The line graph illustrates changes in average household expenditure between 2010 and 2025."
2. income (n)
/ˈɪnkʌm/
thu nhập (tiền kiếm được từ lương hoặc đầu tư)
Collocation: annual income, low-income family, disposable income
"Families often save at least twenty percent of their monthly income for emergencies."
3. budget (n/v)
/ˈbʌdʒɪt/
ngân sách, kế hoạch chi tiêu tài chính
Collocation: monthly budget, tight budget, manage a budget
"University students living away from home must learn to manage a tight monthly budget."
4. investment (n)
/ɪnˈvestmənt/
sự đầu tư, khoản vốn đầu tư
Collocation: long-term investment, foreign investment, make an investment
"Education is widely regarded as the most valuable long-term investment for young people."
5. inflation (n)
/ɪnˈfleɪʃn/
lạm phát (sự tăng mức giá chung của hàng hóa và dịch vụ theo thời gian)
Collocation: rising inflation, rate of inflation
"Due to rising inflation, the cost of fresh food and housing increased significantly."
6. fluctuate (v)
/ˈflʌktʃueɪt/
dao động, biến động lên xuống thất thường (Task 1 Line Graph)
Collocation: fluctuate wildly, fluctuate between... and...
"Fuel prices fluctuated between $60 and $85 per barrel throughout the five-year period."
7. plummet (v)
/ˈplʌmɪt/
giảm mạnh, lao dốc đột ngột (= drop sharply / plunge)
Collocation: plummet dramatically, sales plummeted to
"Spending on printed newspapers plummeted from 25% in 2010 to just 4% in 2025."
8. surge (v/n)
/sɜːdʒ/
tăng vọt, bùng nổ mạnh mẽ (= soar / rocket)
Collocation: surge dramatically, a sharp surge in
"The proportion of online banking users surged from 15% to 80% over the decade."
9. stabilize (v)
/ˈsteɪbəlaɪz/
ổn định lại, giữ ở mức phẳng sau khi biến động (= level off)
Collocation: stabilize at, gradually stabilize
"After rising for three years, the inflation rate finally stabilized at 3% in 2024."
10. gradual (adj)
/ˈɡrædʒuəl/
dần dần, từ từ, đều đặn qua từng giai đoạn
Collocation: a gradual increase, gradual decline (adv: gradually)
"There was a gradual increase in household savings over the ten-year period."
11. dramatic (adj)
/drəˈmætɪk/
đột ngột, mạnh mẽ, đáng kể (dùng mô tả biến động số liệu lớn)
Collocation: a dramatic rise, dramatic fall (adv: dramatically)
"The chart shows a dramatic shift from cash payments to mobile wallets."
12. proportion (n)
/prəˈpɔːʃn/
tỷ lệ, tỷ trọng phần trăm (thay cho percentage trong Task 1)
Collocation: a large proportion of, the proportion of expenditure
"Housing accounted for the largest proportion of total family expenditure in 2025."
13. upward (adj)
/ˈʌpwəd/
có xu hướng đi lên, tăng trưởng (>< downward: đi xuống)
Collocation: an upward trend, show an upward trajectory
"Overall, spending on healthcare and digital services followed a clear upward trend."
14. peak (v/n)
/piːk/
đạt đỉnh cao nhất (v: peak at + số liệu; n: reach a peak of + số liệu)
Collocation: peak at 60%, reach a peak of
"Interest rates reached a peak of 8% in 2022 before declining steadily."
15. forecast (v/n)
/ˈfɔːkɑːst/
dự báo, dự đoán xu hướng tương lai (= project / predict)
Collocation: economic forecast, is forecast to rise
"Clean energy investment is forecast to double by the year 2035."

⚙️ 2. Bài Giảng Ngữ Pháp 2 Tầng (Grammar Masterclass)

🟢 Tầng 1: Hai Công Thức Vàng Mô Tả Xu Hướng Biểu Đồ Đường (Task 1 Line Graph)

• Công thức 1 (Động từ + Trạng từ): Subject + Verb (chia thì) + Adverb
  - Tăng: rose / increased / grew + gradually / steadily / dramatically (hoặc dùng động từ mạnh: surged / soared).
  - Giảm: fell / declined / decreased + slightly / sharply (hoặc plummeted).
  Ví dụ: Household expenditure on digital services rose dramatically from 10% to 35%.

• Công thức 2 (Danh hóa cụm từ — Nâng GRA lên Band 6.5+): There was a/an + Adjective + Noun + in + Subject
  Ví dụ: There was a dramatic rise in household expenditure on digital services between 2010 and 2025.

🔵 Tầng 2: Hệ Thống Giới Từ Trích Dẫn Số Liệu Chính Xác (Prepositions of Data)

• from [Số A] to [Số B]: Tăng/giảm từ mức A lên/xuống mức B.
  Ví dụ: The proportion of income spent on clothes fell from 18% in 2010 to 8% in 2025.

• by [Khoảng chênh lệch]: Tăng/giảm một khoảng bao nhiêu (lấy B trừ A).
  Ví dụ: Monthly food expenditure increased by 12% over the period.

• at [Điểm cố định]: Dùng sau các động từ stand at / start at / stabilize at / peak at.
  Ví dụ: Entertainment spending peaked at 28% in 2020 before stabilizing at 22%.

• reach a peak of [Số]: Danh từ 'peak' đi với giới từ of.

🎯 20 Câu Test Từ Vựng (Vocabulary Mastery Test)

1. The line graph compares average monthly household ________ on housing, food, and transport.
2. Financial advisors recommend saving at least 15% of your monthly ________ in a bank account.
3. Planning a clear weekly ________ helps university students avoid running out of money.
4. Buying solar panels requires an initial ________, but it reduces electricity bills in the long run.
5. When ________ is high, the purchasing power of money falls and everyday goods become more expensive.
6. Between 2015 and 2020, the price of gold did not stay steady; instead, it ________ between $1,200 and $1,800.
7. Due to streaming platforms, DVD sales ________ from 40 million units in 2010 to under 2 million in 2024.
8. During the pandemic, demand for home delivery services ________ dramatically across all major cities.
9. After rising sharply for four years, housing prices finally ________ at around $350,000 in 2025.
10. Unlike the sudden jump in fuel costs, there was a slow and ________ increase in public bus fares.
11. The introduction of smartphones caused a ________ rise in daily internet usage among teenagers.
12. Rent and utilities represent the largest ________ of living costs for young workers in London.
13. Overall, the number of electric vehicles registered in Europe showed a strong ________ trend.
14. Cinema attendance reached a ________ of 180 million tickets in 2019 before falling in 2020.
15. Economists ________ that renewable energy will account for 60% of electricity generation by 2040.
16. [Ôn tập Unit 11] Many graduates look for a profession that offers both fair ________ and job satisfaction.
17. [Ôn tập Unit 8] Governments should ________ public transport so low-income commuters can afford daily travel.
18. [Ôn tập Unit 7] Several old warehouses were ________ into affordable residential apartments.
19. [Ôn tập Unit 6] Teaching teenagers how to save pocket money helps them become financially ________.
20. [Ôn tập Unit 11] Working excessive unpaid overtime every week can lead to severe mental ________.
Điểm: 0/20

⚙️ 10 Câu Test Ngữ Pháp Ứng Dụng (Grammar Mastery Test)

1. Between 2010 and 2025, household expenditure on healthcare rose ________ from 8% to 22%.
2. There was a ________ increase in the proportion of people using mobile banking apps.
3. The percentage of income spent on printed books fell ________ 14% in 2010 to 5% in 2025.
4. Over the ten-year period, monthly spending on renewable electricity increased ________ 18% (from 12% to 30%).
5. After fluctuating for three years, the inflation rate finally stabilized ________ 2.5% in 2024.
6. Investment in financial technology reached a peak ________ $50 billion in 2023.
7. Overall, there was a sharp decline ________ the amount of cash used for daily shopping.
8. According to economic forecasts, online retail expenditure ________ to reach 45% by 2030.
9. In 2010, food expenditure stood at 30%, ________ entertainment accounted for only 10%.
10. The number of young investors fluctuated ________ 2 million and 3.5 million between 2018 and 2022.
Điểm: 0/10

Financial Advisor: Good afternoon! Welcome to the University Student Financial Planning Service. How can I help you?
Student: Hello! I have just moved into a student apartment, and I need advice on managing my monthly budget.
Financial Advisor: I would be glad to help. Could I take your surname for our consultation record? Is it Dawson?
Student: It is actually Morrison. M - O - R - R - I - S - O - N. 💡 Đáp án câu 1 (Đánh vần họ): MORRISON
Financial Advisor: Thank you, Ms. Morrison. What is your total monthly income from your scholarship and part-time job?
Student: I receive a scholarship of £600 and earn £350 working at the library, so my total monthly income is £950. 💡 Bẫy cộng tổng câu 2: 950
Financial Advisor: Let's look at your current expenditure. Which category takes up the largest proportion of your budget?
Student: Rent and electricity bills account for £500 a month, which is more than half of my budget. 💡 Đáp án câu 3: rent / housing
Financial Advisor: Have you noticed any other costs rising recently due to inflation?
Student: Yes! My expenditure on supermarket groceries has surged because I often buy ready-made meals. 💡 Đáp án câu 4: groceries / food
Financial Advisor: Cooking in batches at home can cut your food costs by thirty percent. Do you use a budgeting app?
Student: Not yet. Which free application do you recommend for tracking daily expenses?
Financial Advisor: I suggest downloading SmartPocket. It automatically categorizes every payment and helps you save. 💡 Đáp án câu 5 (Tên ứng dụng): SmartPocket
Student: That sounds really practical. How much should I aim to put into a savings account each month?
Financial Advisor: Even a gradual investment of £80 per month will build a strong emergency fund by graduation. 💡 Đáp án câu 6 (Mức tiết kiệm tháng): 80

📰 IELTS Academic Reading: Passage & Questions

[Paragraph A - Long-Term Shifts in Family Spending (2010–2025)]
Economic data from the past fifteen years reveals a dramatic transformation in how families allocate their monthly income. Between 2010 and 2025, the proportion of household expenditure devoted to housing and healthcare followed a continuous upward trend. Specifically, housing costs rose from 24% to a peak of 36% in 2025 due to urban property shortages and rising inflation.

[Paragraph B - The Decline of Traditional Retail and Cash]
In contrast, spending on printed media and landline telephones plummeted over the same period, falling from 12% in 2010 to barely 2% in 2025. Meanwhile, household spending on fuel and transport fluctuated between 10% and 16% before beginning to stabilize at 13% as more commuters switched to electric public transit. At the same time, expenditure on high-speed internet and cloud subscriptions surged dramatically.

[Paragraph C - Financial Literacy and Future Forecasts]
To cope with economic uncertainty, financial economists encourage young adults to follow a strict monthly budget. Setting aside even a gradual monthly investment into index funds or savings accounts protects families from sudden price shocks. Looking ahead, analysts forecast that digital financial tools will help households track their spending much more accurately over the next decade.
Điểm: 0/6

✍️ Academic Writing Lab (CHUYÊN ĐỀ IELTS TASK 1: LINE GRAPH — Mô Tả Xu Hướng Chi Tiêu Hộ Gia Đình 2010–2025)

Đề bài: The line graph data below shows the proportion of household expenditure on three categories (Housing, Digital Services, and Printed Books/Newspapers) between 2010 and 2025: • Housing: 24% (2010) ➔ gradual rise to 30% (2018) ➔ peaked at 36% (2025). • Digital Services: 6% (2010) ➔ surged dramatically to 25% (2025). • Printed Books & Newspapers: 14% (2010) ➔ plummeted to 3% (2025). Write an Academic Task 1 summary report (75 - 95 words) including an Overview sentence and specific data comparisons.

Tiêu chuẩn: Có câu Overview (Overall,...), kết hợp cả 2 công thức xu hướng (Verb + Adverb và Adjective + Noun), dùng đúng giới từ số liệu (from... to..., by..., peak at...) và tối thiểu 5 từ vựng Unit 12 (expenditure, proportion, upward, surge, plummet, gradual, dramatic, peak).
